title: 6 cyclic cube fields with weight-conditioned admission

claims.statement: The explicit 6-field degree-167 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-34 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 12125704797542587/200000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=363795158065148346627881170867534718892059028777348856557051491376 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(217789/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), orbit count, nominal tails, field and operation bound (1), auxiliary child tails (2), and weighted admission and occupancy (3).
